create_mcp_tool_handler: create an McpToolHandler instance with an MCP client to manage MCP tools
list_mcp_tools: list all available MCP tools by calling the _tools method on McpToolHandler
call_mcp_tool: call an MCP tool by name with optional arguments using the _call_tool method
activate_mcp_handler: activate the McpToolHandler as a context manager to enter and exit the MCP client session
get_mcp_client: get the fastmcp.Client instance from the McpToolHandler client cached property
